item.title: Alcaraz Storms Into Fifth Straight Indian Wells Semifinal
item.description: PIF ATP Rankings: World No.1 Carlos Alcaraz reached his fifth consecutive Indian Wells semi-final on Friday, advancing with a 6-3, 6-4 victory against Cameron Norrie.

item.title: New Zealand Assistant Coaches Ronchi, Oram Granted Leave For PSL Stint
item.description: New Zealand Cricket: Assistant coaches Luke Ronchi and Jacob Oram have been granted leave by New Zealand Cricket (NZC) to take up coaching roles with Islamabad United in the upcoming edition of the Pakistan Super League (PSL) 2026, which begins later this month.

item.title: Indian Wells Open: Svitolina Stuns Swiatek; Rybakina Tops Pegula To Enter SFs
item.description: Indian Wells Open: Elina Svitolina earned a 6-2, 4-6, 6-4 win in 2 hours and 9 minutes to send World No 2 Iga Swiatek packing and reach her second Indian Wells semifinal and first since 2019.

item.title: 'This Trophy Belongs To Every Indian, We Exist Because Of Your Support and Blessings: SKY
item.description: ICC T20 World Cup: Captain Suryakumar Yadav expressed heartfelt gratitude to fans across the country after India’s triumphant campaign in the ICC T20 World Cup 2026, dedicating the title to millions of supporters who stood besdie the team throughout the tournament.

item.title: Theegala Shares Lead After Day 1 At The Players Championship
item.description: The Players Championship: Sahith Theegala produced an impressive performance on the opening day of the Players Championship, carding a 5-under 67 to share the lead before play was suspended early due to darkness.

item.title: The Governing Body Is FIFA, Not Any Individual Country : Iran Fires Back At Trump For Suggesting It Should Skip WC 'for Safety'
item.description: The Iran National Soccer Team: Iran national football team responded sharply to American President Donald Trump for advising their soccer team not to participate in the World Cup for "their own life and safety", stating that "no country can prevent them from participating in the World Cup, which is organised by FIFA, not by any "single nation."

item.title: Polo: Jaipur Register Commanding Win Over Nahargarh In Shree Cement Cup
item.description: HH Maharaja Sawai Padmanabh Singh: The Jaipur Polo Team delivered a composed performance to defeat Nahargarh 7-4.5 in the Shree Cement Cup, showcasing attacking precision and disciplined defence across four chukkers.

item.title: Sunrisers Leeds 'X' Account Suspended Amid Backlash Over Abrar Ahmed Signing For The Hundred
item.description: Wales Cricket Board: Sunrisers Leeds' 'X' account has been suspended hours after the franchise completed the signing of Pakistan spinner Abrar Ahmed during The Hundred 2026 auction held on Thursday.

item.title: ‘Seeing Us Perform Live Inspires Juniors To Aim Higher,’ Says Sumit Antil After WPA Grand Prix Gold
item.description: World Para Athletics Grand Prix: Watching elite athletes compete live can play a crucial role in motivating the next generation, believes Paralympic champion Sumit Antil, who feels such experiences help young athletes set bigger targets for themselves.

item.title: 'Let's Take Whatever We Can To Create Something This Season...': LSG Skipper Pant's Pep Talk To New Faces In Squad For IPL 2026
item.description: South African Anrich Nortje: Lucknow Super Giants captain Rishabh Pant shared a pep talk with the new joinees in the franchise ahead of the IPL 2026, saying that "let's take whatever we can from all these gentlemen here and try to build something for this season."
